scope: 101 README comparison cells: 83 main-table and 18 supplementary; one launch each; Immediate notification unsupported

conditions.collection: 64 UseCase cells followed by 37 restored Foundatio/ShortCircuit/H cells; library rotation within each available comparison set
conditions.statistic: BDN overhead-adjusted arithmetic mean and managed allocated bytes per operation; not independent-run medians

limitations: One machine and one launch per case; no general speed ranking or controlled before/after claim.
API and DI registration shapes differ; Foundatio uses interceptors.
ShortCircuit/H/Foundatio retain historical workload definitions with an untimed measurement entry; they are not the whole checked-in default benchmark matrix.
Native AOT and generated API diagnostic limits are separate from these managed measurements.
